profile.headline: Software Engineer | AWS, Azure, JavaScript, Python
profile.summary:
👨🏻‍💻🧬 As a software engineer with a background in biological sciences and healthcare, I bring a unique perspective to the tech industry. I find satisfaction in meaningful work that incorporates data-driven practices and solutions. I am driven by challenge and have a keen ability to pick up new languages and meet tight deadlines. I have experience working on an Agile/Scrum team and understand the importance of collaboration and communication in delivering quality work.

🚀💻 Whether I am developing full-stack applications, my top priority is always delivering work that is optimized and functional. I approach every task with the intent to learn and grow, and I am always looking for new challenges. With my skills and enthusiasm, I am prepared to take on any project and make a real impact in the tech industry.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Core Full-Stack Software Engineer on an Agile/Scrum cross-functional team of UX designers and developers developing a MERN app.
- Participated in sprint planning, end-of-sprint reflections, and utilizing Atlassian Jira and Confluence for ticket management and documentation.
- Contributed to peer programming, version control with git, pull requests, and code reviews on GitHub, working in multiple branches and in development environments.
- Gained proficiency in Redux, TypeScript, and Sass/SCSS, and contributed to key features such as email verification, user authentication, chat feature, structuring Redux store, global styling variables, React component tree, etc.
- Successfully completed deliverables and features within agreed-upon timelines while working collaboratively utilizing Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Successfully deployed a MERN OpenAI application that utilizes the OpenAI API and MongoDB Atlas to AWS S3 bucket and a serverless hosting site.
- Implemented an AWS CloudFront Distribution to improve performance and security of the application.
- Refactored the codebase to separate the frontend and backend, improving scalability and maintainability for long-term development.
- Set up the configuration for the application to have appropriate scripts and environment variables for both development and production environments.
- Implemented version control using Git with best practices and educated the client on Git usage.
- Participated in live video sessions with the client to demonstrate changes and educate on development processes.
- Communicated with clients to understand their needs and requirements.
- Completed all tasks within the agreed-upon timeline and exceeded client expectations, resulting in a desire to continue working together on future projects.
- Provided ongoing support and maintenance for software systems and debugging.

As a freelance software developer, I have honed my skills in problem-solving, project management, and effective communication. I am actively seeking a full-time role as a Junior Software Engineer and am excited to apply my skills and knowledge to new challenges.

positions.title: Medical Scribe
positions.description:
- Demonstrated exceptional organizational skills managing overbooked shifts, documenting 26 patient histories and physical exams daily, and maintaining confidential patient data, including labs, radiology reports, and medical records.
- Increased patient care by efficiently entering patient data into the EHR software and ensuring completeness of medical records, enabling healthcare providers to deliver high-quality care and make informed treatment decisions.
- Displayed attention to detail and ability to work under pressure by documenting over 110 daily ICD diagnoses, treatment plans, and discharge follow-ups in fast-paced settings, while effectively communicating with collaborating medical teams to ensure accurate and timely documentation.
- Developed training and mentoring skills by leading sessions and guiding incoming scribes on MACRA/HIPAA compliance, promoting team cohesion and ensuring regulatory compliance.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Conducted study trials with large participant pools, ensuring meticulous documentation of research findings and adhering to ethical guidelines.
- Collaborated with fellow Research Assistants to organize and structure research material according to the problem statement, facilitating streamlined data analysis and interpretation.
- Utilized SPSS Statistics software for data entry, cleaning, and analysis to uncover key insights and trends in complex datasets.
- Reported and discussed research observations and findings with team members to promote deeper understanding of results and foster collaboration in addressing research questions.

company.name: Legal Cognition Lab, NSF Criminal Investigations Study

positions.title: Learning Assistant for Human Anatomy
positions.description:
- Led multiple semesters of team-based human anatomy lectures utilizing problem-based learning techniques to enhance student engagement and understanding.
- Collaborated with lead instructors and fellow Learning Assistants to structure course curriculum and develop exam preparation material, ensuring alignment with learning objectives and pedagogical principles.
- Utilized visual learning stations and human anatomy models to facilitate interactive and engaging learning experiences and enhance students' understanding of complex anatomical concepts.
- Proctored multiple exams with strict adherence to proper exam protocols and ethical standards, ensuring fairness and accuracy in the evaluation of student performance.

Led multiple elementary school classes aimed at educating children on proper oral hygiene practices to encourage oral wellness. Constructed a staircase along the mountainside to allow safer access to residents' homes in rural and underserved communities.

volunteerExperiences.description:

- Observed and assisted in a variety of medical services and treatments, including laceration repairs, cast removals, STD examinations, and other procedures, deepening understanding of patient care and medical practices.

projects.title: My Portfolio
projects.description: I was wrestling with whether to use a template or build my own portfolio. I ultimately decided to build my portfolio from scratch using ReactJS and deployed with Firebase. Although I intend to continue optimizing it with more seamless animations and design, I am proud of what I created thus far and the personalization I was able add. Check out my projects!

projects.title: uCutz
projects.description: A go-to platform dedicated to scheduling haircut appointments. Functionality to search for barbershops, schedule appointments with barbers, and review your experience. This is a PERN stack application with implementation of JWT Authentication and AWS deployment.
